subject.title: Cron session accumulation can silently exhaust agent context window — no guardrails or warnings

question: Should maintainers keep this umbrella open while the retention cleanup and recurring cadence guardrail PRs settle, or split/reject the remaining context-warning and cadence-policy pieces now?
rationale: The retention bug is source-backed, but the full request spans compatibility-sensitive session cleanup plus operator-facing scheduling policy that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Linked PRs Settle
options.body: Track the combined user problem here while maintainers decide the retention and cadence PRs, then split only verified leftovers after those decisions land.

options.title: Split Remaining Work Now
options.body: Create narrower canonical issues for retention cleanup, recurring cadence guardrails, context warnings, and sessions cleanup before narrowing this issue.

options.title: Reject Core Cadence Policy
options.body: Keep the retention bug path open but explicitly close or narrow the cadence-guardrail slice if core should not own that policy.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Linked PRs Settle
recommendation.body: Track the combined user problem here while maintainers decide the retention and cadence PRs, then split only verified leftovers after those decisions land.
